briefs.claim_en: Two crocodiles were sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysuru on the evening of October 6, 2026.
briefs.brief_en: Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysuru is a known habitat for crocodiles, with multiple sightings reported over the years. In January 2026, a crocodile was spotted on the bank, causing panic. Other sightings include December 2024 and 2010, when a giant crocodile was seen on the lake bund. There were also reports of a crocodile found dead in the lake in April 2017.
gaps_en: No evidence specifically confirms the sighting of two crocodiles on the evening of October 6, 2026.
No official statements or reports from authorities regarding the claimed sighting were found.
